description: Senate Districts is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. This is the last boundary change until the next redistricting following the 2030 Census. All of the districts now reflect the 2021 Citizens Redistricting Commission(CRC) plan. The only thing that will change is the members' names and parties as elections are held, appointments are made, or party affiliations change. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are Boundaries, CA Senate, CRC, California Citizens Redistricting Commission (CRC), California Senate, Democratic, Districts, Party. The bounding box given is -124.4820,32.5288,-114.1312,42.0095. The hub shows 2025-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
